blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Burnaby total for houses that month.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in Burnaby Hospital?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 13 houses listed in Burnaby Hospital. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Burnaby Hospital a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?
faq.a: In October 2026, houses in Burnaby Hospital had a sales ratio of 8%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many houses sold in Burnaby Hospital from June to October 2026?
faq.a: 8 houses sold in Burnaby Hospital over those 5 months, out of 251 in all of Burnaby.

faq.q: Does this page include townhomes or duplexes in Burnaby Hospital?
faq.a: No. The figures are for detached houses only. Condos and townhomes are counted on their own page.

faq.q: What did houses in Burnaby Hospital sell for?
faq.a: 13 houses sold in Burnaby Hospital between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $2,010,000.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in Burnaby Hospital?
faq.a: The median was 14 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 95.3% of the last list price (0% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
